compiler_limitations.details: Exact frozen fixture/case lists and active3 donor/evaluation IDs. select_case requires exactly3 ordered closed hypotheses and24 rows; assumptions are0/1/2 and final target mark row23. New cohort is not accepted by renaming existing case IDs. Fresh profiles/compiler/auditor/certificate/consumer/target endpoints and all actual q/G/raw source epochs are required.

Rules are axiom/instantiate/eq_subst/assumption/mp only; four finite instantiation rounds, one atomic equality-template layer, zero-port schemes and binary ordered MP. Parsing all/and/not does not give generalization, reflexivity, induction, conjunction-elimination, implication introduction or full first-order completeness. Full same-theory syntax is shared/visible; no target-backcone pruning, only proposed ordering.

Arithmetic point Model.decode requires every C/G/I1/I2 root across the whole length. A first-checked dependency-complete partial proof decoder is not implemented here. Every contributing row needs all4 matching command/guard/input roles and completed strict-prior dependencies; a formula mark is not a theorem.

Existing searched arithmetic grammar uses generalization and separately admitted contextual/induction blocks. Standalone instantiate/induction primitive_schemes are exposed catalogue records, not automatically selectable search actions. Induction predicate comes from the external target body; all its variables are enumerated as alternatives. No arbitrary invariant discovery is claimed.

Checker.proof has explicit ordered assumptions and forbids generalization over the union of free variables of all ambient hypotheses. Induction requires explicit nat-induction plus declared zero/succ; the plain logic.Kernel is not the assumption/induction authority. Native main-proof versus open-block semantics remain separately bound.

arithmetic.definitions: The searched language includes native-admitted contextual rewriting/induction blocks and primitive generalize. Exposed primitive_schemes do not automatically supply standalone instantiate/induction search actions.
arithmetic.point_scope: Current arithmetic is a high-level scalar point adaptation with4 physical role tiles per semantic row, not one primitive Wang square per inference. The endpoint must preserve that representation and its exact occupancy capacity.
arithmetic.unit: All selected C/G/I1/I2 roles for one semantic row, including explicit unused-input markers. Check command/guard agreement, exact mode, arity and every ordered strict-prior source before exposing the output formula.

costs_and_gates.actual_prior_trials: All completed geometry/arithmetic outcomes and failure receipts remain unchanged. A new endpoint applied prospectively is a new experiment; a retrospective census cannot redefine an old UNKNOWN search result.

costs_and_gates.full_cost: Charge metadata preparation, full graph/catalog/feature setup, inference/cluster construction, all candidate observations, complete decode/census/expansion, primitive checking, transforms, exact encoding/capacity, native execution/replay, serialization and complete owned lifecycle. Preserve historical failures separately; do not add overlapping caller/owner/worker subclocks.
costs_and_gates.no_new_budget_or_run: This design issues no new resource allowance, actual model/plan/activation, training/search/native query or publication change.
costs_and_gates.physical_resource: Keep the then-frozen common native physical workspace/checker/palette and owned time/memory ceilings. No automatic heap or microstep increase on failure.

future_endpoint.goal: One shared certificate/result protocol for arithmetic and symbolic geometry, with small domain-specific selected-unit/primitive-expansion adapters; the search/controller and checking authority remain distinct.

invariants.UNKNOWN: Incomplete source, encoding, decoding, capacity, resource, primitive checking, native response or independent replay remains UNKNOWN at that exact layer. No easier target, scope narrowing, resource reset or earlier failed-result rescue.
invariants.ancestry: Backward-close the target root under every declared ordered strict-prior source dependency. Pending source rows, guard points, mode-only assignments and unsatisfied induction premises give pending_dependencies, never established hypotheses.
invariants.expansion: Reconstruct commands from original licensed primitive records and admitted block/family definitions. Reported proof words, proposal scores, names, cached booleans and target equality flags are not authority. A call is an exact ordered premise binding, not a new axiom.
invariants.occurrences: Equal formulas at different Gamma indices remain distinct original occurrences. Preserve unused original occurrences and their ambient free-variable restrictions. Every assumption command binds its exact original index and AST.
invariants.one_exact_context: Pin the original signature, all closed axioms and enabled schemas, complete ordered Gamma with occurrence indices and hashes, exact target AST, catalog/inventory/license epochs, model/boundary and executable source maps. Parameter roles remain metadata, never extra hypotheses or sorts.
invariants.physical: Keep all original placement coordinates/identity preimages. Check exact unit t-values and agreement of all m-support including exterior/target/remote marks. Bind the extracted patch to the actual full selected state and check its current-state union independently.
invariants.proof_vs_board: A theorem certificate may use fewer occupied points than the finite board requires. Remaining board obligations are retained; proof acceptance never claims a full board or infinite tiling.
invariants.scheduler: Observation never chooses placements or alters graph domains, global dead/forced/earliest-generation decisions, full primitive fallback, controller waiting/retirement or paired rollback.
invariants.units: A marking on an unoccupied point is a constraint, not a fact. Zero is assigned. A semantic proof unit exists only when its entire declared physical role support is selected, all ordered source ports resolved, and its full primitive identity/expansion licensed.

learned_cluster_proposals.construction: A future policy may construct receptor bindings and irregular unions of primitive placements; descriptor/member identities and ordered premise bindings are independently expanded and validated before any preference becomes active.
learned_cluster_proposals.library_promotion: New inventory admission is a separate exact certificate/native/independent/resource gate and new versioned epoch. No automatic proof promotion from a proposal/kernel flag; revalidate live states if inventory changes.
learned_cluster_proposals.lifecycle: Keep explicit NULL/full base fallback and unchanged Controller priorities. Trail any learned selection overlay with the graph; waiting, mandatory forced interruption, retirement and rollback remain exact.
learned_cluster_proposals.proposal_vs_selection: A checked hypothetical target proposal is separately proposed_only. It never counts as the actual selected endpoint, board completion or proof-search success until the predeclared primary criterion is met.
learned_cluster_proposals.reward: Reward only independently resolved, dependency-complete original-context facts or accepted primary certificates. Unoccupied output marks, pending MP/induction sources and hypothetical unions earn no proof reward. Declare deduplication and failed/resource costs prospectively; no repeated reward for one proof.
learned_cluster_proposals.same_authority: The graph is the legality source; validate full t/m/current union and stale context/authority/snapshot digests. No target word, hand-authored winning route or successful ordinary proof enters features, seeds or training.
learned_cluster_proposals.transfer: Freeze donor/held-out contexts and equal-inventory controls before proposals or target outcomes. Learning selection/composition of existing families is distinct from learning new family topology or admitting a discovered lemma.

observation_protocol.all_states: Decode the entire authenticated actual result and retained event/state set. Check source/model/context digests and full selected-unit census before selecting an endpoint. Keep raw complete result and all earlier rejected/pending/UNKNOWN checks.
observation_protocol.attribution: Mathematical proof acceptance, actual search-state provenance, complete trajectory conformance, native acceptance and full-board acceptance are separate flags. A valid certificate with an UNKNOWN trajectory audit does not establish accepted GCTS search attribution.
observation_protocol.future_online_extension: Only a separately reviewed/preregistered observer hook can synchronously check a post-placement snapshot. Initial proposal is non-stopping. Any future first-proof stopping mode is a new objective/budget boundary; it must preserve the mandatory scan, complete chosen-domain lists, interrupted forced/waiting statuses and exact rollback checkpoint.
observation_protocol.initial_implementation: Use an observational sidecar over the complete frozen actual trace, with the unchanged search run finishing normally. No online early-stop or reward change in the first implementation. This avoids modifying scheduler, backtracking or current result semantics.
observation_protocol.mandatory_decision: Bind each observation to the recorded mandatory global graph decision and complete source state. A dead remaining board still causes normal DFS branch rejection; the sidecar may separately certify an already selected theorem subpatch, with board_dead recorded and no continuation/board acceptance claim.
observation_protocol.target_detection: Inspect actually selected complete unit outputs using injective original formula IDs/ASTs. A fixed target mark without selected output is not an endpoint.

quantifier_and_induction.blocks: Each body is checked under its own exact ordered local premises. Expand a call with hygienic scopes and remapped prior references, or preserve its checked hierarchy with a fully bound native definition dependency closure. Local assumptions never escape as theory axioms.
quantifier_and_induction.generalization: The current serialized checker forbids free variables from every ambient undischarged hypothesis, including unused occurrences. Do not weaken this to the target ancestry dependency set. Proper generic deduction can discharge assumptions before generalization; record that transformation and certify its output.
quantifier_and_induction.induction: Bind the actual predicate template, induction variable, all parameter closures and enabled schema/signature. Both base and step are independently obtained premises; a pending step or an induction-hypothesis receptor is not a completed proof. All declared induction-variable alternatives stay in the unchanged search grammar.
quantifier_and_induction.negative_scope: Plain logic.Kernel lacks the full assumption/induction request semantics and is not a substitute for the serialized/native checker authority.
quantifier_and_induction.sharing: Share or slice proofs only within identical theory/Gamma/scope/forbidden-variable context. A formula equal under different ambient assumptions is not automatically interchangeable. Preserve original target and all theory/context bindings; recertify transformations.
quantifier_and_induction.signature_scope: Use exactly the current addition/induction fragment and explicitly enabled nat-induction schema, not full Peano arithmetic or unrestricted FOL completeness. Geometry and arithmetic share a request language, not automatically one identical admitted inference catalog.
quantifier_and_induction.substitution: Preserve ordered quantifier binders, capture-avoiding substitution and the frozen alpha/fresh-name policy. Exact AST equality is the default; any alpha-normalization is a separately audited transport law.

terminology.checked_ground_proof: An exact original-context primitive sequent certificate. Host and native acceptance are separate fields. A native claim requires the actual unchanged universal checker/parser/palette request and independent whole replay, not a Python kernel result alone.
terminology.first_checked: First accepted item in a predeclared chronological observation order, with every attempted check/unknown preserved. It is not a shortest proof, earliest mathematically valid proof, or complete proof-search claim.
terminology.ground: A fully instantiated finite certificate under an exact frozen signature/theory and indexed context. This does not mean quantifier-free: the formula AST can contain quantifiers, and scoped eigenvariables must obey the checker. No schematic metavariable or unresolved receptor remains in an accepted certificate.
